assets.title: One sample, two readings
assets.description: An identical cobalt sample sits in warm and cool surrounds, then travels through source, profile, display or export, and viewer.
assets.visual_grammar: Hold one sampled colour constant; vary its surround, then map the digital chain to the viewer.

assets.title: A working lens for judging effects
assets.description: A disclosure-by-claim-change matrix separates disclosed stylisation, declared alteration, context-dependent judgment, and deception risk.
assets.visual_grammar: Map how much an edit shifts the image's claim against whether the shift is disclosed; leave the threshold open to context.

assets.title: Colour treatment and garment claim
assets.description: A fictional jacket appears as neutral source, expressive colour treatment, and a polished version with a garment detail removed.
assets.visual_grammar: Hold the fictional garment and framing constant; distinguish mood styling from an edit that changes the represented garment.

assets.title: Keep the source; make each edit inspectable
assets.description: A five-step workflow preserves the source, isolates an editable mask, applies effects on a separate layer, compares the result, and exports with a one-line disclosure.
assets.visual_grammar: Preserve the before; isolate the target; keep effect editable; compare intent and claim; disclose what changed.

assets.title: A textile colour moves from sample to screen
assets.description: A fictional design-studio still places a cobalt textile sample beside its screen rendering, a neutral card, and a colour reference strip to prompt questions about viewing conditions.
assets.visual_grammar: Set a physical sample beside a screen and reference materials; invite comparison across display and ambient viewing conditions without claiming calibration accuracy.

assets.title: A masked treatment that keeps the garment intact
assets.description: Three aligned fictional fashion-still frames show the source, an editable mask, and a background treatment while retaining the garment's structure.
assets.visual_grammar: Align one fictional source, an editable mask, and a restrained selective treatment; keep garment shape and detail stable so process logic stays visible.
